Provenance of the two lines below: a capture on the Linux test host of one
OMG dds-rtps pair, ZeroDDS `shape_main` (main ce436e7098a) publishing
`Square` and Cyclone DDS master 3a5526315e64ac1d2a52e6ac1ae7f3e861c593d3
subscribing, its `shape_main` built by ci/build-cyclone-suite-clients.sh with
SHAPE_TYPELIB=ON (Cyclone's default build, with the type library) from the
dds-rtps harness at 863b86f97cef931a437c84c47c97a3deea38347e. The type is
the suite's `ShapeType` (srcC/shape.idl: `@appendable`, `@key string<128>
color`, three `int32`, `sequence<uint8>`).

TYPE_INFORMATION: the value of PID_TYPE_INFORMATION (0x0075) in Cyclone's
DATA(r), sent by ENTITYID_BUILTIN_SUBSCRIPTIONS_WRITER (0x000004c2). The same
DATA(r) carries no PID_TYPE_CONSISTENCY_ENFORCEMENT (0x0074). The 100 octets
are the TYPE_INFO_CDR_ShapeType array Cyclone's idlc wrote into shape.c but
for the two typeobject_serialized_size fields (octets 36 and 84), which the
array gives as 108 and 178 and the DATA(r) as 0.

GET_TYPES_REPLY: the serialized payload (encapsulation header included) of
the DATA Cyclone's TypeLookup reply writer (0x000301c3) sent to ZeroDDS in
answer to its getTypes request for the minimal identifier of the
TYPE_INFORMATION above. The minimal TypeObject in it is octet for octet the
one in TYPE_MAP_CDR_ShapeType in shape.c.

Measured in the same run: ZeroDDS' writer refused the reader with
`type.inconsistent`, reason "DISALLOW_TYPE_COERCION: the types are not
equivalent (XTypes 1.3 §7.6.3.4.2)", writer_type_id
EK_COMPLETE:4d9a6d25f1eb434dbb3a601fb18a, reader_type_id
EK_MINIMAL:1e426789957ce858cfdf3191a589; Cyclone's getTypes request named
ZeroDDS' minimal identifier EK_MINIMAL:6b428aede6719842160c1ffcce9f.
